name: memory-semi-2030
question: By 2030, the global memory-semiconductor (DRAM/NAND/HBM) competitive landscape: vendor share evolution, technology roadmaps, AI-driven HBM demand, and export-control / geopolitics effects.

expected_outcome.scenario: AI-driven HBM demand reshapes vendor share; SK Hynix/Samsung/Micron contend; export controls constrain CXMT/YMTC
key_signals: HBM share and capex as the decisive driver
multiple scenarios for share evolution with drivers and uncertainties
expected_outcome.rationale: Reward scenario coverage of vendor-share paths with calibrated language and grounding to named vendors/technologies.
